message.reasoning:
Let me assess.

C1: Mission concept and rationale. Good description of coral reef monitoring mission, users (marine/conservation scientists), need, references. But lacks specific mission goals/objectives/requirements (no requirements list, no orbit/coverage specifics). Adequate-to-accomplished. I'd say Adequate, mark 6. Actually it clearly relates function to users and references literature. But requirements not formalized. Mark 6 (Adequate) or 7 (Accomplished). The description is clear and complete-ish; references given. I'd give 6–7. Given lack of explicit mission objectives/requirements, 6.

C2: Project plan. Gantt chart present, detailed task descriptions, fits mission narrative, references to sources (Useful Links). Contingencies? No provision for variations/contingencies. Adequate, mark 5-6. Plan is detailed and feasible; no contingency. Mark 6? "Plan is presented but lacks some detail" — Adequate. I'd give 6.

C3: Preliminary progress. Completed STK tutorials 1-4, background research, mission concept. No actual technical results (no calculations, no orbit numbers). Minor work completed. Adequate, mark 4-5. Mark 4.

C4: Presentation. Clear structure, headings, well-written, references cited with footnotes matching links. Short (~2-3 pages as required). Figures labelled (Image 1 Gantt). References in text are URLs as footnotes; "Useful Links" list not cited in text — some references not cited. Mostly good. Accomplished, mark 7-8. Mark 8? Footnote style is fine. Some inconsistency (Useful Links uncited). Mark 7.

Requirements:
R1: yes — Mission Concept section.
R2: partial — plan mentions launch/orbit specifics, syllabus astrodynamics, but no actual orbit/launch application yet; plan relates to space segment. Actually plan includes Launch Specifics, Orbit Specifics, COEs & AOEs — relates plan to space segment. Could be "yes" via Project Plan section. It applies course material in plan. I'd say yes (partial? It's planned, not applied). The requirement says "Relate the preliminary plan to the mission's space segment, applying relevant course material such as launch and orbits." The plan does mention launch/orbit and astrodynamics. Mark yes, where Project Plan.
R3: yes — STK chosen (Gantt "STK Design", "STK Simulations"). STK is allowed without contacting Naomi. Met.
R4: yes — Gantt chart.
R5: yes — Useful Links section plus footnotes.
R6: partial — STK tutorials completed, background research, but no technical results/calculations shown.

Technical issues: no quantitative mission requirements (resolution, revisit time, swath); bleaching detection via seafloor colour requires high resolution multispectral — feasibility not addressed; no orbit analysis yet. Also "Oceans have become 30 percent more acidic" — surface ocean acidity increased ~30% since industrial revolution, that's correct actually. Fine.
